lag_result.required_framing: No qualifying within-window co-occurrences were confirmed in the lag-eligible population under the project's strict dating rules. This should not be interpreted as evidence that government support was followed by no outcomes; the available dates generally cannot establish when support began.

mechanism.note: Both actual-date anchors are EXPLICIT_ADDITION events dated after the athlete's major-games outcomes -- a later re-addition event, not a first-support date.

financial_relationship.verdict: Cannot currently be estimated from available public evidence.
financial_relationship.reason: All genuinely-dated support rows in the lag-eligible population are accounting_stage == NOT_FINANCIAL (PIB batch-release/induction events); none carry a SANCTIONED or RELEASED_PAID stage.
